title: Prototype the affirmation editor in srs-lab? The goal is the method editor and reusable components (2026-10-28)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Would it make sense to prototype in SRS labs? Control room already has ab affirmation system we can build the whole thing there. But the real goal is to use the method editor and build the set of reusable components.

This process is related to the agent supported editor, but has a different goal.

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-28, after the affirmation-editor chain was found stuck behind srs-rust#1473 (finding b514ca75); recorded verbatim (one message, split by thought).
